Learn more → At Conception X, we turn researchers into founders of tomorrow's most influential companies We create deeptech companies at scale by backing top researchers at the moment they’re most likely to found. How we think Our Venture Science model is designed for founders building from their research. 01— We start with talent. We back exceptional scientists at the earliest stage, scouting continuously across 100+ universities to identify researchers advancing the frontier of their field who also show a unique combination of qualities – including high intellectual ambition and early market curiosity. We then help them develop an entrepreneurial mindset during their PhD and postdoc. We’ve found that 34% of researchers start companies with this support – compared to 1.7% without. 02— Scientists make better founders. Not every scientist should be a founder, but we believe that the most consequential companies of the next decades will be built by researchers. Conception X is for scientists who can't stop thinking about what their research could become – and have the drive and ambition to find out. We call them Venture Scientists. START WHERE YOU ARE Researchers join us early, although at different stages. Our programmes are designed to complement your academic journey, and support progression from idea formation to first fundraise – and beyond. Early PhD or postdoc, curious You're early in your research, but curious about the founder path and ready to explore whether it's for you. Mid-research, exploring You’ve explored entrepreneurship through workshops or hackathons and want to define your vision, team and commercial framework. Mid-research, gaining traction You're forming a team, planning partnerships or pilots and starting to understand the investment landscape.
